changelog: New: Combo integration via Commander Spellbook (MIT, ~30k variants) — every analytical layer is combo-aware (goldfish, gauntlet, mulligan, power, archetype, brackets, cuts, adds, coach, version diff, exports)
New: 'Combos broken' save toast names which combo lines a save dropped from your deck
New: Duel 'Analyst compare' panel renders combo gained/lost between deck A and deck B
New: One-shot stale-combo banner — when the local Spellbook cache is 90+ days old, prompts you once per cohort to refresh
New: densa-deck combos verify <deck> <combo_id> — debug helper showing per-piece presence + color-identity fit
New: analyze --with-llm now auto-protects combo pieces from cut suggestions and frames the deck's combo plan in the analyst's prose
New: Brackets + near-miss combo detection + AI deckbuild + multi-format export (MTGA / MTGO / Moxfield)
Prior: MTGA-style Build tab with live mana curve, pip count, format validity (shipped in v0.2.0)
